text:
Alex: Quick sync — planning kernel + quant profile rollout tomorrow 06:00 UTC. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2345. Plan is canary -> ramp -> rollout. Need owners for canary, smoke, and rollback. Estimated active window 45m.
Maya: I can take canary + perf/smoke. Will validate two canary slices (s1,s2).
Ravi: I'll own rollback readiness and slot claims. Confirming quant bump from v1.06 to v1.08? PR says v1.07 in diff.
Jordan: PR link above. Note: KV cache layout changes — we need warm restart steps. Preflight command: `./infra/warm_restart.sh --slice canary`
Alex: Timeline: 06:00-06:20 canary (5% traffic), 06:20-06:40 ramp (20%), 06:40-07:00 full. Auto-fallback policy: if p95 latency >150ms for 2 consecutive minutes, route to model-compat fallback. @deploy-bot will emit start/finish.
Maya: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
```
# smoke.sh
./bin/generate --model gpt-redwood-13b --prompt 'Hello' --max-tokens 100
measure_latency.py --target p95
check_error_rate.sh --threshold 0.5%
```
I'll post outputs here.
Ravi: Rollback runbook (short):
1) scale down new runtime ASG
2) revert k8s deployment to tag `runtime:stable`
3) restore KV checkpoint if needed: `./infra/restore_kv --slice canary`
I'll be ready to execute.
Jordan: Need one more reviewer on the PR. @Lina can you take a look? Also make sure canary weight progression is codified in deploy manifest (weights: 5,20,100).
Lina: On it, will review tonight. Quick question — does this require customers to pin model version? If yes we need migration notes.
Alex: No customer pin required; rollout is internal. Also prod quant-profile will be set to `balanced-v2` (recommender). Docs updated under infra/quant_profiles.md
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Alex at 2024-06-20T06:00:00Z. Will post status updates during window.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll post smoke outputs and a short summary (latency/errors/memory) within the canary window.
Ravi: I'll monitor rollback metrics and open incident if we trigger fallback. Otherwise will close thread after post-checks.
Alex: Thanks — capture any anomalies in the post-run notes. If nothing smells, we'll promote. End of thread.
